plugins.description: Checkmarx-powered security scanning and fixing inside your coding loop. Checks the code you write and the code AI generates for vulnerabilities and risky dependencies, then returns precise, engine-backed fixes. Best invoked after writing or changing code, before commits, and around security-sensitive logic. Applies fixes inline so you can accept them without leaving your editor.
